name: artifact-sftp
description: Publish self-contained HTML artifacts to your own SFTP web host with a stable URL and private-by-default visibility, then read the locally archived bytes for artifacts just published.

interface.shortDescription: Publish and read HTML artifacts on your SFTP host
interface.longDescription: Uploads one self-contained HTML file per artifact to an SFTP web host, returns a stable private-by-default URL, and provides a local archive that agents can read back without fetching a Cloudflare Access-protected viewer link.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report as an artifact
Update my published artifact in place
Read the artifact I just published
Set up artifact-sftp on this machine
